name: Triple-confirmed post-news drift — bullish headline x momentum x calm DVOL (long spot)
rationale: CROSS-METRIC THREE-WAY confirmation (news_event_score x ret_Nd x dvol) — a meta-labeling-by-confirmation refinement of llm-narrative-pressure-long (which uses only news + momentum). The post-news drift hypothesis is real but noisy: a bullish headline only drifts cleanly when (a) price is already confirming (momentum up) AND (b) the regime is calm (low implied vol), because in a high-DVOL/stress regime a bullish headline gets swamped by macro fear and the drift fails. Adding the orthogonal DVOL calm gate is the third, independent confirmation that prunes the failed-drift regime the two-arm news spec cannot. Mechanism before data: long spot when news_event_score is above a fitted bullish floor AND ret over a window is positive AND dvol is below a fitted calm ceiling; exit on momentum flip. Distinct from llm-narrative-pressure-long (news + momentum, no vol regime), g2-news-overreaction-reversion (extreme-NEGATIVE news, contrarian), and dvol-calm-regime-momentum (no news arm). Disconfirmer 1: drop the dvol arm — if news + momentum alone matches the deflated Sharpe, the calm gate adds nothing and this is the existing narrative-pressure spec. Disconfirmer 2: drop the news arm — if calm momentum alone matches, the news adds nothing. The edge must require all three. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT/cost): three gates may shrink effective-N below the gate floor (the min-trades guard catches it); news_event_score is PIT; net of ~20bps the drift must clear. tier1 news_event_score + tier0 ret_Nd/dvol, fresh prod data, unproven combination — low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: a bullish news_event_score CONFIRMED by positive momentum AND a calm DVOL regime — triple-confirmed post-news drift, long spot
